import sys
import math

mo = 1000000007

def power(x, y):
    s = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            s = (s * x) % mo
        x = (x * x) % mo
        y //= 2
    return s

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    I100 = power(100, mo - 2)
    P_values = data[1:]
    f = [[0] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        f[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(n):
            P = int(P_values[i * n + j])
            p1 = (P * I100) % mo
            p0 = (1 + mo - p1) % mo
            for k in range(1 << j):
                f[i][k | (1 << j)] = (f[i][k | (1 << j)] + f[i][k] * p1) % mo
                f[i][k] = (f[i][k] * p0) % mo

    cnt = [0] * (1 << n)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        cnt[i] = (cnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1))
    vec = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    id_map = [0] * (1 << n)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        vec[cnt[i]].append(i)
        id_map[i] = len(vec[cnt[i]]) - 1

    from functools import lru_cache

    @lru_cache(None)
    def DP(x, sta):
        if sta == 0:
            return 0
        if x == n:
            return 1
        ans = 0
        for j in range(1, (1 << n)):
            nxt = 0
            for k_idx, las in enumerate(vec[x]):
                if not (sta & (1 << k_idx)):
                    continue
                for l in range(n):
                    if (j & (1 << l)) and not (las & (1 << l)):
                        nxt |= 1 << id_map[las | (1 << l)]
            ans = (ans + f[x][j] * DP(x + 1, nxt)) % mo
        return ans

    print(DP(0, 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
